findings.problem: Three [CONFIRM ...] placeholders (lines 9, 10, 13: first step, second step, price and plans). Rule forbids placeholders in send-ready files.
findings.fix: Get owner answers, fill in exact steps and price, and list open items in the owner-questions note in notes/ until then.

findings.problem: [CONFIRM] placeholders on lines 8, 10, 12 (box contents, extras, brew steps). Line 12 states 'each tea comes with simple steps' as fact, which is unconfirmed.
findings.fix: Confirm box contents and brew steps with the owner, then replace placeholders with exact details. Remove the brew-steps claim if not confirmed.
Confirm gifting with the owner and explain it, or delete the line.

findings.problem: 'If you have a question, just reply to this email' promises replies, which the owner has not confirmed (same line in email 04, line 12).
findings.fix: Confirm a monitored reply address with the owner, or remove the line from emails 02 and 04.

findings.problem: 'You can start your subscription today' is an unconfirmed timing claim. Repeated on line 8 of all three group variants. Offer and pause/cancel questions in the voice file are also still open.
findings.fix: Confirm the sign-up is live and the offer is settled, or reword to avoid a timing claim.

findings.problem: Implies gifting exists ('subscription for someone you have in mind', 'for a birthday'), but email 04 treats gifting as unconfirmed.
findings.fix: Confirm gifting, or remove the gift wording until it is confirmed.

findings.problem: Sign-up is described in different words across emails 01, 02 and 04. The rule requires the same wording where emails describe the same thing.
findings.fix: Once the steps are confirmed, use one standard sign-up sentence in all emails.
